fit_reason: Whole pickup truck listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Water bottle and charging cable left in the front cup holder and console area
Light dust and lint on the front and rear floor liners
Gray cloth seats look slightly dull and lived-in on the driver seat and rear bench
Tan paint looks a bit flat rather than glossy on the hood and tailgate
Black step bars and bumper end trim look faded and grayish
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2004 Ram 2500 and it looks like a solid truck. A pre-sale detail could freshen up the cloth seats and floor liners and bring back some gloss on the tan paint and the faded black step bars. We come to you. Would you like a quote?
